turns.text: Yeah, exactly, trying to stick to the caffeine cutback. And yes, I've got a couple of client calls this morning, so I actually put on a button-down shirt today.

turns.text: Sam is doing great, just busy with work. We actually caught up for a bit this morning. Speaking of lunch, I think I'm going to grab some vegetarian ramen today from that spot down the street.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, ramen sounds absolutely perfect for a chilly December day in Chicago. Have you had any time to pick up your guitar lately, or has work been too crazy?

turns.text: I actually played for about an hour last night! Just practicing some acoustic chords. It's a great way to wind down before the workweek starts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She has! We chatted on Saturday. She and her husband are still glowing after the wedding. It was such a great celebration, but she's definitely glad the planning stress is finally over.

turns.text: I bet! Wedding planning is a massive undertaking, so I'm sure she's relieved to just enjoy being married now. Are you doing any running these days, or are you taking a break after your big Austin half marathon run earlier this year?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm still running a bit to stay in shape, but definitely not at that intense training level. Just some casual jogs around the neighborhood when the weather permits. Anyway, I should probably jump on this first client call!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Understandable, don't let me keep you! Have a great call, enjoy your lunch, and have a productive Monday, Leo!
